text: Danavorexton (developmental code name TAK-925) is a selective orexin 2 receptor agonist that functions as a small-molecule compound and is administered intravenously. In a phase 1 clinical trial, it was shown to produce wakefulness in a dose-dependent manner comparable to modafinil. As of March 2021, danavorexton is being developed for the treatment of narcolepsy, idiopathic hypersomnia, and sleep apnea. It is related to firazorexton (TAK-994), another orexin receptor agonist, whose development was discontinued in October 2021 due to safety concerns.
